items.question: What proportion should the shoulder bear to the throat, and what is said about root decay?
premises: shoulder should be level with throat
root is mentioned together with decay
yor? carries an unresolved genitive reference
items.inference: The verse prescribes shoulder-throat levelness and names root decay.
uncertainties: the referent of yor? is unclear
the exact grammatical role of mūlaṃ is ambiguous
items.plain_english: The shoulder should be level with the throat; of which? root decay.
